title: Equivalent fractions by adding the same number
statement: You get an equivalent fraction by adding the same number to the numerator and the denominator, or by subtracting the same number from both.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: complete an equivalent fraction with a given denominator
evidence_patterns.signature: adds the difference in denominators to the numerator
subtracts the same number from numerator and denominator

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent across items; the learner defends it as 'you have to do the same to both'. A slip is a single wrong numerator with multiplicative reasoning elsewhere.

vs.math.frac.cancel-matching-digits: Digit cancellers only act when a digit repeats (16/64); additive reasoners act on any fraction.
